connect_pybullet_vr_server: connect to a pybullet physics server using SHARED_MEMORY or GUI mode for VR simulation
get_vr_events: retrieve VR controller events including position, orientation, buttons, and analog axes from pybullet
draw_debug_line_in_vr: draw a colored debug line in the pybullet simulation using addUserDebugLine with position and width
reset_simulation_and_clear_debug: reset the pybullet simulation and remove all user debug items then reload the plane URDF
load_urdf_and_set_search_path: set the additional search path for pybullet data assets and load a URDF model into the simulation
